thesis: This episode argues that TSMC is the most successful and important B2B hardware company of all time, possessing an impenetrable moat that rivals Microsoft. It suggests that while the GPU market is significant, the core value driver is the demand for chips for gaming consoles like PlayStation, rather than machine learning or crypto.
